name: Big Ear Pedals
author: Tone Zone
description: Hand-painted boutique pedals inspired by BIG EAR pedals (Nashville): the bread-loaf fuzz family, a Kalamazoo-style distortion, octave and one-knob fuzzes, the pizza-slice fuzz, a reverb, an ambient modulator, a low-gain drive, boosters (including the nine-footswitch one), a short delay and a mini buffer.
